=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_release_smoke_run_lookup.py:378-380 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The contract test still has `assert wf.count('find_latest_scoped_run_field "${TEST_REPO}"') == 3`, but the PR adds a fourth call site at .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3744. The four call sites are lines 947, 1116, 1498 and 3744.
  WHY: CI job tests-promote-stall-and-review fails with an AssertionError at line 380 (run 42826836586, job 129866253697), which also fails the aggregate `lint` gate. All reviewers rated this BLOCKER.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:33965-34275 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The guard `judge_tracking_issue_closed_skip judge-addition` at 33966 skips only the judge-addition block. Because the wave counts are then unchanged, the `in_progress)` arm falls into the wave-advance `else` at 34055 (`persist_orch_redecompose`, NEXT_WAVE) and calls `gh issue create` for the next wave's `ai:clarification` sub-issues (34216-34275).
  WHY: A project whose tracking issue is closed still gets next-wave issues, and then PRs, in the same tick (#8837/#8838/#8841/#8842-class residue). This breaks the goal "The judge never creates issues for a project whose tracking issue is closed". All reviewers rated this MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3740-3750 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The late-Implement cancel `LATE_IMPL_RUN_ID="$(find_latest_scoped_run_field "${TEST_REPO}" "${IMPL_CREATED_AFTER_INPUT:-}" "Implement" "${ISSUE_TITLE}" "id" 3 || true)"` picks only the single newest matching run. The selector is `sort_by(.created_at) | last` with no active-status filter (scripts/comprehensive_test_and_release_gh_api.sh:240-250). The alt-model cleanup (~5470-5482) instead cancels every run matching `select(.status != "completed")`.
  WHY: If a newer run has already completed, the cancel hits that run and an older queued or in-progress run survives to open a late PR for the closed smoke issue. Severity disagreement: sonnet rated this NIT/3, and the other four rated it MAJOR/4.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4813-4817, 10283-10293 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `get_issue_state_labels_json` returns an "open" fallback when the API read fails, and `judge_tracking_issue_closed_skip` skips only when the state is literally "closed". So the guard fails open, and tests/test_orchestrate_judge_tracking_closed_guard.py:60-64 asserts that fail-open behaviour.
  WHY: A closed tracking issue combined with a transient GET failure still produces judge-addition or fix-up issues for the closed project. Severity disagreement: gemini, minimax and luna rated this MAJOR; glm rated it NIT/3 and noted the behaviour is deliberate and documented.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:517-522 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The smoke issue-state read uses `2>/dev/null || true`, so an API error leaves `smoke_issue_state=""`. The age-rule `elif` then still sets `smoke_close_reason=max_age` and closes the PR.
  WHY: An aged smoke PR is closed even though the issue read failed, but the issue says "An API error means skip the close and continue". The existing test only covers the non-aged case (test_issue_read_error_keeps_only_age_rule). Severity disagreement: gemini, minimax and luna rated this MAJOR; glm rated it NIT/3.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:4853-4862 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `for attempt in 1 2 3` retry around the `orchestrator/project-<N>` ref DELETE ("Cleanup orchestrate test issues", Phase 3) logs nothing after the last failed attempt. Every other best-effort action in the step, such as close_with_retry, emits `::warning::`.
  WHY: The integration branch this phase exists to remove can survive with no diagnostic in the release-gate log.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3756-3759 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The late-PR close runs `gh api ... -X PATCH -f state=closed -f body=...`, which replaces the whole PR description. The sibling `PR_NUMBER` branch (3726-3733) reads EXISTING_PR_BODY and appends to it instead.
  WHY: Late smoke PRs lose their plan, linked-issue reference and pre-push gate report, which is the evidence needed to find out why Implement started late.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:299-313 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: `closed_smoke=${closed_smoke}` is added only to the AUTOFIX_SWEEP_END line at 633. The zero-candidate exit (299) and the default_branch_unavailable exit (313) do not emit it.
  WHY: Log consumers that parse `closed_smoke=` will find it missing on early-exit ticks. The value on those paths would be 0, so the impact is small.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "The judge never creates issues for a project whose tracking issue is closed"; Tests: "Judge guard: closed tracking issue means no `gh issue create` and the skip log is written"
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, `in_progress)` arm between the guarded `if` (~33966) and the wave-advance `else` (34055); tests/test_orchestrate_judge_tracking_closed_guard.py
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: No hunk stops the arm or skips the wave advance and the next-wave `gh issue create` (~34270, 34220-34275) when judge_tracking_issue_closed_skip returns 0. tests/test_orchestrate_judge_tracking_closed_guard.py asserts only the guard function's own behaviour and where it sits in the text; no case checks that the in_progress arm makes no `gh issue create` call when the tracking issue is closed.
- requirement: The new `find_latest_scoped_run_field "${TEST_REPO}"` call must be reflected in the contract test, and the existing contract tests must still pass.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_release_smoke_run_lookup.py:380
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: No diff hunk touches tests/test_release_smoke_run_lookup.py, although the PR grant includes `tests/**`. The workflow now has four call sites (947, 1116, 1498, 3744), but `== 3` remains, and CI shows an AssertionError at this line.
- requirement: "count it in `AUTOFIX_SWEEP_END` as a new `closed_smoke=` field (added, not renamed)"
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml, every path that emits AUTOFIX_SWEEP_END (lines 299, 313)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The zero-candidate exit at line 299 and the `default_branch_unavailable` exit at line 313 emit AUTOFIX_SWEEP_END without `closed_smoke=`; only the normal completion at line 633 includes it. Severity disagreement: minimax rated this BLOCKER, gemini MAJOR, and luna and glm NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- tests/test_release_smoke_run_lookup.py:380 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `assert wf.count('find_latest_scoped_run_field "${TEST_REPO}"') == 3` is not updated for the fourth call site added in "Cleanup test artifacts".
  WHY: CI job tests-promote-stall-and-review fails with an AssertionError (run 42826836586) and fails the `lint` gate. The fix is to change the count to 4 or to check each call site by its context.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~33966, 34037-34055, 34270 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The closed-tracking guard skips only judge-addition, so control falls into the wave-advance `else` and runs next-wave `gh issue create` (or advance/finalize on the final wave).
  WHY: This is the #8834 scenario: the guard logs ORCHESTRATE_JUDGE_ADDITION_SKIP and the same tick still opens `ai:clarification` issues for the closed project. The guard test checks only the guard's position in the text.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:"Cleanup test artifacts" elif branch (scripts/comprehensive_test_and_release_gh_api.sh:240-250) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Only the newest non-skipped matching Implement run is cancelled, whatever its status, while the alt-model cleanup cancels every matching run with `select(.status != "completed")`.
  WHY: An older active run can survive and open a late `ai/issue-<N>` PR. The 6 h sweep backstop limits the damage, and the issue's wording allows a single run.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:"Cleanup orchestrate test issues" Phase 3 branch-delete loop | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Nothing is logged when all three delete attempts fail.
  WHY: The `orchestrator/project-<N>` branch survives without any trace in the log. The fix is a `::warning::` after the loop.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:"Cleanup test artifacts" late-PR loop | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `-f body=` overwrites the whole PR description, while the PR_NUMBER branch above reads and appends.
  WHY: The late PR's original body, which is the evidence for why Implement started late, is lost.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:299, 313, 633 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `closed_smoke=` is added to only one of the three AUTOFIX_SWEEP_END emitters.
  WHY: Log consumers find the field missing on zero-candidate and default_branch_unavailable ticks.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "The judge never creates issues for a project whose tracking issue is closed"; Tests: "Judge guard: closed tracking issue means no `gh issue create` and the skip log is written". Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh judge `in_progress)` arm between ~33966 and 34055. Evidence of absence: no hunk stops the arm before the wave advance or the `gh issue create` (~34270), and no test exercises the arm. SEVERITY: MAJOR. ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: the PR's existing contract tests must still pass after the new cleanup call site is added. Expected change site: tests/test_release_smoke_run_lookup.py:380. Evidence of absence: no diff hunk touches the file, the count still says 3, and CI fails. SEVERITY: BLOCKER. ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (2 related items): (1) in the judge in_progress arm, set `judge_tracking_closed=1` and `continue` before the WAVE_ISSUE_COUNT_AFTER comparison (5 lines); (2) add a `::warning::` after the Phase 3 branch-delete loop (3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3.
- Notes, not raised (3 related items): the fail-open read in judge_tracking_issue_closed_skip is a documented choice; the age rule after an issue-read error in review_autofix_sweep.yml:517-522 is documented as intended in agents.d/8953-smoke-pr-cleanup.md; the copilot-pull-request-reviewer failure (custom_instructions_too_large, 422) is infrastructure, not this diff.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
